therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: PPARα agonism combined with HMG-CoA reductase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: comprehensive dyslipidemia correction (TG reduction, HDL-C elevation, LDL-C reduction)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of subjects reporting adverse events during combination therapy

results.effect_size: 83–86% of subjects reported adverse events across arms
results.target_engagement_evidence: Median TG reductions of 47.7–56.2%; HDL-C increases of 19.4–25.2%; LDL-C reductions of 30.2–41.6% at Week 52
biomarker_changes: Median TG change: -53.0% (rosuvastatin arm), -47.7% (simvastatin arm), -56.2% (atorvastatin arm)
Mean HDL-C change: +25.2% (rosuvastatin arm), +25.1% (simvastatin arm), +19.4% (atorvastatin arm)
Mean LDL-C change: -41.6% (rosuvastatin arm), -30.2% (simvastatin arm), -38.1% (atorvastatin arm)
Mean Non-HDL-C change: -48.8% (rosuvastatin arm), -36.6% (simvastatin arm), -44.3% (atorvastatin arm)
Mean VLDL-C change: -56.9% (rosuvastatin arm), -37.7% (simvastatin arm), -52.2% (atorvastatin arm)
Mean total cholesterol change: -37.9% (rosuvastatin arm), -27.5% (simvastatin arm), -35.0% (atorvastatin arm)
Mean Apo B change: -44.8% (rosuvastatin arm), -35.5% (simvastatin arm), -42.9% (atorvastatin arm)
Median hsCRP change: -38.87% (rosuvastatin arm), -27.72% (simvastatin arm), -39.13% (atorvastatin arm)
safety_signals: 83% of subjects in ABT-335 + rosuvastatin arm reported AEs
86% of subjects in ABT-335 + simvastatin arm reported AEs
85% of subjects in ABT-335 + atorvastatin arm reported AEs
Serious cardiac events reported across arms including acute MI, angina, atrial fibrillation, cardiac arrest

dose_info.dose: ABT-335 135 mg; rosuvastatin 20 mg or atorvastatin 40 mg or simvastatin 40 mg

context.comparator: No comparator (open-label, single-arm per statin group)
